test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records readings at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
Access to EMS software and data logs.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS software interface for a continuous period of at least 10 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are displayed in real-time for all monitored GMP storage areas.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the EMS interface showing real-time temperature data.

test_steps.action: Access the system's data logs or database and review recorded temperature data for the observed period.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are recorded at intervals of 5 minutes or less for each monitored area.
data_to_capture: Exported data log showing timestamps and temperature readings.

acceptance_criteria: All GMP storage areas show continuous temperature monitoring.
Recorded temperature data confirms intervals do not exceed 5 minutes.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is recorded accurately and without loss.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range and accuracy, and generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
Access to EMS software and alarm configuration.
Calibrated external temperature source for testing.

test_steps.action: Set a known temperature within the specified range (-80°C to +50°C) using a calibrated external source near a sensor. Record the EMS displayed temperature.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displayed temperature is within ±0.5°C of the known temperature.

test_steps.action: Adjust the setpoint for a monitored area. Then, simulate a temperature deviation of +2°C from the setpoint using the external source. Verify alarm generation.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated by the EMS within 30 seconds of the temperature deviating by +2°C from the setpoint.

test_steps.action: Adjust the setpoint for a monitored area. Then, simulate a temperature deviation of -2°C from the setpoint using the external source. Verify alarm generation.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated by the EMS within 30 seconds of the temperature deviating by -2°C from the setpoint.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are accurate within ±0.5°C.
Alarms are generated within 30 seconds for ±2°C deviations from setpoint.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm triggers are reliable and timely.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system uses vendor-supplied software without modification and that all data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Access to system logs and configuration files.
Access to the EMS database.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS system's software installation directory and compare file checksums/versions against vendor-provided documentation or installation media.
test_steps.expected_result: All EMS software files match the vendor-supplied versions and show no signs of modification.

test_steps.action: Generate a sample report or export data from the EMS system. Examine the exported data file structure and format.
test_steps.expected_result: The exported data adheres to the vendor's standard database format (e.g., CSV, SQL dump, specific proprietary format).

acceptance_criteria: The EMS software is confirmed to be unmodified from the vendor's supplied version.
The data storage format is verified as the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a format that ensures its integrity and can be reliably retrieved.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification Integration and Response Time
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates alerts when temperature deviates from setpoint and that these alarms integrate with the site paging system within the specified response time.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational and configured with setpoints.
Site paging system is operational and configured to receive notifications.
Access to EMS alarm logs and paging system logs.
Ability to simulate temperature excursions.

test_steps.action: Configure an EMS temperature setpoint and a ±2°C deviation alarm threshold. Manually adjust a sensor reading (or simulate an excursion) to trigger the alarm.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS system generates an audible and/or visual alarm notification within the system.

test_steps.action: Observe the site paging system for the incoming alarm notification. Record the time from alarm generation in EMS to receipt of notification on the paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The site paging system receives the alarm notification within 30 seconds of the alarm being generated in the EMS.
data_to_capture: Time of alarm generation in EMS
Time of notification receipt on paging system

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification contains relevant information (e.g., location, temperature, deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification provides sufficient and accurate information for response.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature alarms are generated by the EMS system upon deviation from setpoint.
Alarm notifications are successfully sent to the site paging system.
The response time from EMS alarm generation to paging system notification is within 30 seconds.
Alarm notifications contain accurate and relevant information.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be accurately logged and time-stamped.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system maintains a comprehensive audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A simulated event requiring an audit trail entry (e.g., configuration change) is planned.

test_steps.action: Perform a configuration change within the EMS system (e.g., adjust a setpoint or alarm threshold).
test_steps.expected_result: The system logs the change in the audit trail, including user, date, time, and the nature of the change.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entries for the configuration change.

test_steps.action: Initiate an action that requires an electronic signature (e.g., approving a report or acknowledging an alarm).
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for and captures a valid electronic signature, linking it to the action.
data_to_capture: Electronic signature details associated with the action.

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail and electronic signature records for completeness and accuracy.
test_steps.expected_result: All audit trail entries are present, accurate, and clearly indicate who performed what action and when. Electronic signatures are correctly associated with the relevant events.
data_to_capture: Screenshots or exported audit trail and signature data.

acceptance_criteria: All configuration changes are logged in the audit trail with sufficient detail.
Electronic signatures are captured correctly and are linked to the appropriate actions.
The audit trail and electronic signature data are tamper-evident and meet 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be complete, accurate, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures must be unique, attributable, and non-repudiable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can store data for at least 10 years and that the archival feature functions correctly.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists or can be simulated to test archival.
Access to the vendor's archival mechanism is available.

test_steps.action: Simulate or utilize existing data to represent 7 years of continuous monitoring.
test_steps.expected_result: The system continues to log new data without performance degradation.
data_to_capture: System performance metrics during data logging.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival process for data older than 7 years.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives the specified data, freeing up active storage space.
data_to_capture: Status of active data storage before and after archival.

test_steps.action: Verify that archived data is retrievable and remains intact.
test_steps.expected_result: Archived data can be accessed and is presented in its original format.

test_steps.action: Assess the system's ability to store data for a minimum of 10 years based on current data generation rates and storage capacity.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's storage capacity is projected to support 10 years of continuous monitoring.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully archives data older than 7 years.
Archived data is retrievable and remains in its original format.
The system's storage capacity is sufficient to support 10 years of continuous monitoring.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be accurate, complete, and accessible.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Usage for Batch Release
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-provided standard reports for batch release purposes as required.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Access to EMS reporting module.
Sample data exists within the system for reporting.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The reporting module is accessible and displays available report options.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the reporting module interface.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard report for a specific time period (e.g., a batch cycle).
test_steps.expected_result: A report is generated successfully using the vendor's standard template.

test_steps.action: Review the generated report to confirm it contains relevant monitoring data and is in the vendor's standard format.
test_steps.expected_result: The report accurately reflects the monitored data for the selected period and adheres to the vendor's standard report layout.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of data accuracy and format adherence.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully generates standard reports.
Generated reports are in the vendor's specified format.
Reports contain accurate and relevant monitoring data.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Report generation does not alter original data.
Report format is consistent and verifiable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS meets the specified system availability and data storage capacity requirements.
prerequisites: EMS has been operational for a sufficient period to assess availability.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools.
Knowledge of system maintenance schedules.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 1 month) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: The total unplanned downtime is within the acceptable limit for 99.5% availability.
data_to_capture: Dates and durations of unplanned downtime.

test_steps.action: Review system logs and database size to estimate current data storage usage.
test_steps.expected_result: Current data storage usage is significantly below the capacity required to support 10 years of continuous monitoring.

test_steps.action: Consult system documentation or vendor support to confirm the total data storage capacity of the system.
test_steps.expected_result: The total data storage capacity is confirmed to be sufficient for at least 10 years of continuous monitoring.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is >= 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
Data storage capacity is sufficient to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-012: Data storage capacity shall support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.
URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: System availability ensures continuous data capture.
Sufficient storage prevents data loss due to capacity limits.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Facility Management System Integration and Alarm Notification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can successfully interface with the existing facility management system and send alarm notifications via the site paging system.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Facility management system is operational.
Site paging system is operational.
Vendor API for alarm notifications is available and documented.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition in the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS system generates an alarm and sends a notification to the site paging system.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of notification received on the site paging system.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm information is correctly transmitted and displayed in the facility management system.
test_steps.expected_result: The facility management system displays the correct alarm details received from the EMS.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the facility management system showing the alarm.
Timestamp of alarm display in the facility management system.

acceptance_criteria: Alarms are successfully transmitted to the site paging system.
Alarm details are accurately reflected in the facility management system.
Integration with the facility management system functions as per URS-EMS-014.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure no data loss or corruption during transmission between systems.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity for 10 Years
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system meets the required availability of 99.5% and has sufficient data storage capacity to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
prerequisites: EMS system is fully operational and has been running for a significant period (e.g., several months).
Access to system logs and performance monitoring tools.
Knowledge of the system's data storage configuration and growth rate.

test_steps.action: Review system logs and performance metrics to calculate the actual system availability over a defined period (e.g., last 3 months).
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated system availability is >= 99.5%, excluding documented planned maintenance.
data_to_capture: List of any unplanned downtime events and their causes.

test_steps.action: Analyze current data storage usage and project the storage requirements for 10 years based on the current data logging rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The current storage capacity, or planned upgrades, are sufficient to accommodate 10 years of data.
data_to_capture: Details of current storage hardware and its capacity.

acceptance_criteria: System availability meets or exceeds 99.5% (excluding planned maintenance).
Data storage capacity is confirmed to be sufficient for a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
System performance is stable and does not degrade over time.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure that system downtime does not lead to data loss.
Verify that data storage mechanisms are robust and reliable.
